name: International Wire Transfer (Corporate) — Sanctions Block
description: Corporate Client initiates an international wire. During pre-execution compliance (PH-031), SVC-051 Sanctions Screening detects a match on the beneficiary. SVC-010 publishes TransferFailed (EVT-057) with reason=sanctions_block. InternationalTransfer.status=sanctions_blocked. MLRO is alerted. Customer receives a generic decline — tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A) prevents disclosure of the specific reason. OFSI notification required within 14 days if a designated person is confirmed.

steps.label: Enter beneficiary details, amount, currency; complete SCA
POST /international-transfers { beneficiary details, amount: 50000.00, currency: EUR }
Validation passes. Create ENT-026 InternationalTransfer: status=pending_compliance, transfer_id=xfer-20260415-0099001
Publish EVT-049 InternationalTransferInitiated { transfer_id: xfer-20260415-0099001, beneficiary details }
Consume EVT-049 → sanctions screening (beneficiary + correspondent BICs)
Screen Sanctioned Entity Corp: OFSI match found — designated person
Publish EVT-051 TransferSanctionsScreened { transfer_id, outcome: hit, match_ref: OFSI-2024-0421, result_id: scr-0099001 }
Sanctions hit on beneficiary → set InternationalTransfer.status=sanctions_blocked; raise MLRO alert
Publish EVT-057 TransferFailed { transfer_id, reason: sanctions_block, sanctions_result_ref: scr-0099001 }
steps.note: OFSI notification required within 14 days if designated person confirmed (GOV-005-R02)

steps.label: Route EVT-057 → Notifications (SVC-053): send generic decline to customer (no specific reason — POCA 2002 s333A tipping-off prohibition)
Generic: 'We are unable to process this transfer. Please contact your Relationship Manager.'
steps.note: Tipping-off prohibition: specific sanctions match reason MUST NOT be disclosed to customer
